details: Bitcoin experienced substantial outflows from spot Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) totaling $1.72 billion in the past week, marking the second-largest weekly outflow since their inception. This contributed to Bitcoin's price falling below $62,000, with some analysts suggesting a potential drop to $50,000. Demand for Bitcoin is reportedly at its lowest since 2019, indicating a potential "cleansing phase" in the market.
title: Bitcoin Sees Significant ETF Outflows Amid Price Decline

details: While Bitcoin ETFs saw outflows, Ethereum ETFs attracted $82.37 million in inflows, indicating a relative confidence in Ethereum amidst a broader market downturn. Additionally, BitMine Immersion Technologies made its largest weekly purchase of 2026, acquiring 126,971 ETH for approximately $207 million at an average price of $1,630, increasing their total holdings to 4.59% of Ethereum's circulating supply. Ethereum's price has recently fallen to around $1,630, facing resistance at the $1,700 level.
title: Ethereum Sees Inflows into ETFs Despite Market Weakness

details: The Humanity Protocol (H) token experienced a significant price plunge, dropping as much as 88% after an alleged $30 million wallet drain reportedly caused by an employee laptop breach.
title: Humanity Protocol Token Crashes Amid $30M Security Breach

details: Decentralized finance (DeFi) lending protocol Morpho Labs successfully raised $175 million in one of the largest fundraising rounds in the DeFi sector. The round, led by Paradigm, a16z Crypto, and Ribbit Capital, values the protocol at $2 billion and aims to accelerate its institutional DeFi initiatives.
title: Morpho Labs Raises $175M, Valued at $2B for Institutional DeFi Push

details: Zcash (ZEC) has seen a significant rally, climbing 80% since June 5, following the announcement of its upcoming Ironwood upgrade scheduled for late July. This technical and ecosystem news has driven considerable positive movement for the altcoin.
title: Zcash (ZEC) Surges 80% with Ironwood Upgrade Announcement
